description: After Darken Rahl's invasion reaches the Midlands, Richard Cypher learns he is the Seeker named by prophecy and crosses the Boundary with Confessor Kahlan and wizard Zedd. Their campaign against Rahl becomes a race for the three Boxes of Orden, whose combined magic can command anyone; Richard also discovers the truth about his family, including Jennsen and Zedd. When Richard finally assembles Orden and Kahlan uses her Confessor power, the clash destroys Rahl but also tears open the veil to the Underworld.

s01e01-02.description: Kahlan Amnell crosses the Boundary seeking the Seeker after Darken Rahl's forces seize the Book of Counted Shadows and kill Richard Cypher's adoptive father. Zedd reveals Richard's identity, gives him the Sword of Truth and joins him and Kahlan in pursuing Fane; their first campaign recovers the Book, rescues Chase's kidnapped daughter and commits Richard to carrying the Seeker's role into the Midlands.

s01e03.description: Darken Rahl offers a bounty for the Seeker and equips hunters with enchanted maps that can track Richard's movements. Richard, Kahlan and Zedd have to identify how the hunters are finding them and turn the tracking magic against the men pursuing the reward.

s01e04.description: Richard returns to Brennidon, the town where Rahl's soldiers killed firstborn sons in an attempt to prevent the Seeker prophecy. The visit exposes how thoroughly the occupation has reshaped the town and gives Richard new information about the woman who gave birth to him and the circumstances of his escape as an infant.

s01e05.description: D'Haran soldiers capture Renn, a child Listener who can hear other people's thoughts, intending to use his ability against the resistance. Richard and Kahlan free him, but protecting Renn also means coping with a boy who can immediately expose feelings and secrets that Richard and Kahlan have been avoiding with each other.

s01e06.description: Villagers in Drundril are buying bottled elixirs that temporarily grant magical abilities and are becoming dependent on powers they do not understand. Tracking the source leads Zedd to a former student who is manufacturing the potions and forces the wizard to confront how his own teaching helped create the problem.

s01e07.description: Shota foresees Richard being killed by D'Haran commander Demmin Nass and responds by magically exchanging Richard's body with that of villager Gryff. Richard has to stop Nass while everyone around him sees the wrong face, and Gryff is forced to survive the attention that comes with being mistaken for the Seeker.

s01e08.description: Kahlan leaves Richard and Zedd temporarily because she fears her growing feelings will interfere with her duties as a Confessor. Mord-Sith Denna captures Richard in her absence and uses an Agiel and psychological conditioning to break his loyalty, forcing Richard to resist becoming a weapon for Darken Rahl.

s01e09.description: Queen Milena possesses the last Box of Orden that Darken Rahl still needs, so Zedd enters her court disguised as a puppeteer to replace the box with a fake. A servant girl named Rachel becomes essential to the theft, while Richard and Kahlan race Rahl's forces to keep the genuine box from reaching him.

s01e10.description: Kahlan infiltrates a D'Haran prison with Richard to rescue her pregnant sister Dennee, another Confessor. After Dennee gives birth to a boy, Richard learns that Confessor law requires male children to be killed because their power is considered uncontrollable, placing his determination to save the infant directly against Kahlan's inherited duty.

s01e11.description: Richard and Kahlan investigate murders inside the resistance while Zedd looks for a secure place to hide a Box of Orden. False evidence and a confession obtained through Kahlan's power lead to the death of an innocent man, forcing her to reassess how easily the Confessor's certainty can be manipulated by someone controlling the facts around a suspect.

s01e12.description: Rahl's wizard Giller traps Richard inside a constructed version of his old Hartland life using the Spell of the Lying Moon. The illusion is designed to persuade Richard that the Seeker quest never happened and extract the location of the Box of Orden, while Kahlan and Zedd work from outside the spell to bring him back to reality.

s01e13.description: Richard, Kahlan and Zedd take a Box of Orden to the crypt of legendary Seeker Kieran, expecting the tomb to provide a safe hiding place. The spirits of Kieran, Confessor Viviane and wizard Amfortas instead possess the living visitors and replay the betrayal that destroyed their own alliance, forcing the present-day group to resolve a conflict inherited from the past.

s01e14.description: D'Haran troops occupy Hartland and take members of Chase's family, drawing Richard back across the Boundary to the home he left behind. Richard, Kahlan and Chase organize a rescue while confronting townspeople who have accepted the occupation as the price of avoiding further punishment.

s01e15.description: Giller experiments with dead Confessor magic in an attempt to give Darken Rahl the power of Confession, using prisoners as test subjects. Richard's effort to free the captives brings him face to face with Rahl and reveals how close the regime is to turning a uniquely Confessor ability into a controlled military tool.

s01e16.description: Richard rescues Jennsen from Denna and learns that she is his half-sister, hidden from Rahl because she was born without the magical gift that permeates their bloodline. Her immunity to magic makes her valuable to both sides and also forces Richard to confront another part of the family history concealed from him.

s01e17.description: Richard infiltrates a D'Haran weapons operation to steal Whisperers, devices capable of destroying entire villages, before they can be used against the resistance. Once the weapons are captured, Richard must also stop resistance fighters from using the same indiscriminate power for revenge against D'Haran civilians.

s01e18.description: Two thieves obtain magic that lets them impersonate Richard and Kahlan and begin exploiting the Seeker and Confessor identities for profit. The real pair must recover the Sword of Truth and clear their names while their doubles discover that pretending to hold those roles also attracts the enemies attached to them.

s01e19.description: A king trying to defend his realm from D'Haran soldiers accepts Shota's magic and is transformed into a beast that hunts the occupiers at night. When the creature begins killing the people it was meant to protect, Richard and Kahlan have to separate the king from the curse before fear of Rahl destroys the kingdom from inside.

s01e20.description: Richard learns that another prophetic volume may contain information about defeating Rahl and travels to a library where the manuscript has been hidden. Rahl's agents arrive for the same reason, turning the search into a contest over whether the Seeker or the tyrant will control the prophecy's guidance.

s01e21.description: Jennsen comes into possession of two Boxes of Orden and is captured before she can deliver them safely to Richard. After losing her memory, she is manipulated by Rahl into believing Richard is responsible for her suffering, leaving the Seeker to recover both his sister and the boxes without harming someone Rahl has turned against him.

s01e22.description: The release of Orden's power throws Richard and Cara decades into a future where Rahl's victory has reshaped the world and Kahlan's life. Richard has to work with the Mord-Sith who once served his enemy to understand how the altered history was created and undo it, restoring the confrontation that can actually end Rahl's rule.
